verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own bulk operations: fetching all repositories and merging every updated repository with a single tap, and a Resolve tool that settles conflicts across many files at once. These are limited to specific actions, and there is no evidence of general multi-select or bulk commit/push across repositories. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk/multi-select operations across arbitrary items, bulk commit/push across repositories, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can pull the list of repositories down to Fetch for all your repositories. If any of your repositories received new commits you will be able to Merge all these repositories with a single tap.
A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.
